about.title: Gentle, specialist care that starts with healthy gums
paragraphs: Dr. Sindhu Dental Clinic on Ashramam Road, Tadepalli, is led by Dr. Sindhu, MDS — a periodontist with over 15 years of experience. Gum health is the foundation of every plan here, because fillings, crowns and implants last longest on healthy gums and bone.
An oral and maxillofacial surgeon and a root canal specialist complete the team, so most problems can be treated at one clinic by the doctor trained for them.
points: Clear explanations and costs before treatment
